The '''Baroli sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Baroli/Legends|Baroli]], [[Cridark II]], [[Fleyars IV]], [[Gacerian]], [[Tentrix]] and [[Vernet]].
